summary: Negatives centre on stalled drain work and open pits in Ganganagar, unannounced power cuts in Kankarkhera and across Meerut, and sealing fears among Sadar Bazar traders, while appreciation is for MLA-fund interlocking roads in Ganganagar, Kankarkhera and Sharma Nagar.

positives.english: Interlocking roads built in Ganganagar ward 37 with MLA's fund
positives.hindi: गंगानगर की वार्ड 37 में इंटरलॉकिंग सड़कें बनीं
positives.basis: Newsprahari (undated, URL month 2026-05): MLA Amit Agarwal inaugurated about Rs 60 lakh of roads and drains from his MLA fund, including 180 m and 230 m interlocking roads in ward 37 Ganganagar and Global City Colony. Ward 37 is listed in the AC extent on Wikipedia

positives.english: Roads and drains built in Kankarkhera from MLA's fund
positives.hindi: कंकरखेड़ा में विधायक निधि से सड़क और नाली बनीं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut dateline, Sunday 7 June 2026): Cantt MLA Amit Agarwal inaugurated about Rs 33.67 lakh of road and drain work from his MLA fund in New Govindpuri, Ganpati Vihar and Nangla Tashi, Kankarkhera area

positives.english: A 1,300-metre interlocking road built in Sharma Nagar from MLA's fund
positives.hindi: शर्मा नगर में 1300 मीटर लंबी इंटरलॉकिंग सड़क बनी
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Sanvad, Meerut, 15 Oct 2025): 1,300 m interlocking road in Sharma Nagar (Bhamashah Park) built from MLA fund for about Rs 15.62 lakh; the article reports residents welcomed it. AC membership of Sharma Nagar not confirmed in the Wikipedia extent

positives.english: Roads built in Durga Nagar Kailashpuri and Sanjay Nagar from MLA's fund
positives.hindi: दुर्गा नगर कैलाशपुरी और संजय नगर में सड़कें बनीं
positives.basis: Newsprahari (undated, URL month 2026-05): 100 m road in ward 67 Durga Nagar Kailashpuri and 100 m road in ward 46 Sanjay Nagar, part of about Rs 60 lakh MLA-fund works. Wards 67 and 46 are listed in the AC extent on Wikipedia

positives.english: A 100-metre interlocking road built in a Durganagar lane
positives.hindi: दुर्गानगर की गली में 100 मीटर इंटरलॉकिंग सड़क बनी
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Sanvad, Meerut, 15 Oct 2025): 100 m interlocking road in Virendra Tomar lane, Durganagar (Patel Nagar mandal, Garh Road), built from MLA fund for about Rs 8 lakh. AC membership of this locality not confirmed in the Wikipedia extent

negatives.english: Sadar Bazar traders fear sealing and demolition of their shops
negatives.hindi: सदर बाजार के व्यापारियों को सीलिंग और तोड़फोड़ का डर सता रहा है
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat (1 Oct 2026): Supreme Court order to seal and demolish 16,726 illegal constructions in Zone-A of Meerut city; traders from Sadar Bazar, Khairnagar, Sarafa, Kagzi Bazar and Lala ka Bazar sought an ordinance and warned of street protests. Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026) reports about 17,000 black flags put up in markets. Sadar Bazar AC membership not confirmed; district-level

negatives.english: Drain work in Ganganagar stalled for weeks, leaving an open pit that fills with water
negatives.hindi: गंगानगर में नाला निर्माण 17 दिन से रुका, गड्ढे में पानी भरा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): PWD drain work in Ganganagar stalled for 17 days near Hotel Royal 9, leaving an open pit with accident and mosquito risk; the 3 Jul 2026 report says the work had stalled for 19 days, with no barricades or lighting. Ganganagar ward 37 lies inside the AC per Wikipedia extent

negatives.english: Power is cut for four hours at a time in Kankarkhera without notice, residents allege
negatives.hindi: कंकरखेड़ा में बिना सूचना चार-चार घंटे बिजली कटौती का आरोप है
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat (28 Jun 2026): Kankarkhera residents blockaded the power house, alleging 4-hour cuts without prior notice, and said officials ignored complaints. Kankarkhera's AC membership is supported by the Amar Ujala 7 Jun 2026 report of Cantt MLA works there, not by the ETV article itself

negatives.english: Power goes off for three to five hours in several Meerut areas in summer
negatives.hindi: मेरठ में कई इलाकों में तीन से पांच घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut Bureau, 24 Jun 2026): outages of three to five hours in several areas including Kankarkhera, Garh Road, TP Nagar and Khairnagar; residents complained of heat and traders of disrupted business. District-level, not AC-specific

negatives.english: When it rains the Abu Nala overflows and water spills onto the road
negatives.hindi: बारिश में आबू नाला लबालब, सड़क पर पानी आ गया
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (28 Jul 2026): after heavy rain the Abu Nala overflowed and spilled onto the road, making travel difficult; waterlogging was reported in several parts of the city. No locality within the AC is named; district-level

notes: AC number, name, district and reserved status confirmed from the Wikipedia UP constituency list (row 47 Meerut Cantt., Meerut, None) and the Meerut Cantonment page, which gives the extent as Meerut (CB) plus MNC wards 1, 6-9, 18, 23, 26, 30, 32, 37, 40, 44, 52, 59, 61, 63, 64, 66, 67, 70. Confirmed inside AC: Ganganagar (ward 37), Durga Nagar Kailashpuri (ward 67) and Sanjay Nagar (ward 46). Kankarkhera is treated as inside AC because the Cantt MLA's own-fund works are reported there, but it is not on the extent list; a field check is advisable. Sharma Nagar, Durganagar, Sadar Bazar and Patel Nagar AC membership is unconfirmed. The Newsprahari article carries no day-level date (URL month 2026-05). Searches for AC-specific civic problems in Hindi and English mostly returned city-wide or other-city results; the Patrika (17 Aug 2026) and Navjivan pieces contained no concrete local grievances (the Patrika mention of resentment is a BSP claim). Several WebFetch attempts on Newsprahari-linked and other pages were checked directly; no citation relies on a headline alone. The Meerut-district negatives (power cuts, Abu Nala waterlogging, Sadar Bazar sealing) are Meerut-wide and are not claimed as AC-only. Field check recommended on Ganganagar drain pit status post-monsoon and on current Kankarkhera power supply.
